item.title: The 3-2-1 Code Challenge
item.description:
Idea

A weekly checklist with the goal of honing my tech skills and finding me a job in the area. The idea came about after I was looking for ways to be more productive (and get a job faster!)

Execution

Simple checklist, cannot get it wrong.

  • ✅ 3 programming exercises from Leetcode
  • ✅ 2 job applications
  • ✅ 1 blog post

Then, I will update this post weekly with the list and some stats. Hope it works!
